title: Jujutsu Kaisen Reveals 12 New Culling Game Character Posters Ahead of Season 4
content:
JUJUTSU KAISEN revealed 12 new character poster visuals for Culling Game Arc Part 1 (Season 3) ahead of Season 4.

It was previously announced that Takeru Sato, who served as the assistant director in Season 3, will also direct the new season. Shota Goshozono’s role is listed as chief director. Sato commented: I feel the weight of the responsibility of being entrusted with such an important title every day. I am drawing great strength from the passion and accumulated efforts of the staff and cast who have supported Jujutsu Kaisen up to this point.

You can see the new visuals below.

Gege Akutami’s JUJUTSU KAISEN manga officially ended on September 30, 2024. It was serialized for 6-and-a-half-years since March 2018, with the story getting concluded in 30 volumes. Volumes 29 and 30 both released on December 25, 2024. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English. Studio MAPPA previously animated both seasons of the TV anime and movie for the franchise, while Crunchyroll is streaming them. The story follows Yuji Itadori, a boy with insane physical abilities who ends up joining a school for jujutsu sorcerers after an encounter with Megumi Fushiguro, Satoru Gojo and Sukuna Ryomen. To delay getting executed for eating one of Sukuna’s fingers, Yuji takes on the task of finding and eating the remaining 19 fingers of the ‘strongest sorcerer in history’ in order to try and get rid of him. However, things don’t quite go as smoothly as they’d like.

Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo spin-off manga later began as a short-term serialization in Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 41, released on September 8, 2025. The second volume was published on March 4, with the third and final volume releasing in Japan on May 1. The series also released an animated trailer following its conclusion.

A teaser visual and trailer were recently revealed for Season 4.
author: Anime Corner

title: Dragon Ball Creator Akira Toriyama’s Home Is Being Torn Down According to Eye-Witness Reports
content:
According to new eye-witness reports from those in the area, the former home and studio of the late Dragon Ball creator Akira Toriyama is currently being demolished, and those involved with the franchise over the years have shared their confusion about it all with fans on social media. The legendary creator died at the age of 86 back in 2024 , and that unfortunately marked a new era for the long running franchise. On the cusp of its 40th anniversary, the franchise revealed it had some big plans for the future even without Toriyama.

As spotted by @mr.gentleman1966 on Threads , the late creator’s home has been in the midst of demolishing efforts. Following that initial reveal over the weekend, other users have shared their photos to further emphasize that it’s really happening. Though the family for Toriyama’s estate have not revealed a reason as to why, nor have they revealed they’re doing it at all, fans all over social media have shared their shock and surprise including former Dragon Ball editors and animators.

Dragon Ball Editors & Animators Share Their Reactions to Bird Studio’s Fate

In the wake of the surfaced images hitting social media , Chikashi Kubota, the chief animation director of Dragon Ball Super: SUPER HERO , “It’s far too soon for Toriyama-sensei’s home to be demolished. This is heartbreaking.” Former Dragon Ball editor Kazuhiko Torishima shared the following , “The place I visited once a month… The place where so many characters and works were born is disappearing. So he’s really gone…” Unfortunately, the situation is a bit more complicated than fans might be hoping to hear.

There’s no real reason given as to why Toriyama’s former home is being demolished, but that’s likely never going to be revealed given that it’s something decided on by the late creator’s family and those handling his estate. The actual taking down of the property wasn’t even going to be “announced,” it just happened to be noticed by those nearby. Unfortunately, while it’s a significant location to those honoring Toriyama’s history , there’s never going to be anything truly revealed about what it takes to inherit such a property.

What’s Next for Dragon Ball’ s Future?

Although Akira Toriyama’s former home and studio will cease to be, thankfully the Dragon Ball franchise itself is going stronger than ever before. It made its return to TV screens with a brand new remake anime series for Dragon Ball Super over a decade after its initial debut. The newly enhanced series is going all the way back to the beginning with the Battle of Gods arc, and is showing off new takes on the Resurrection F and Universe 6 arcs to follow in the episodes to come.

That’s not going to be all that’s on the way either as Dragon Ball Super has also confirmed they are now working on a brand new anime next. Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol has been announced as a new anime adapting the first of the exclusive manga arcs yet to hit screens, the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc . No release window or date has been announced for the next iteration of the anime franchise, but it’s something to look forward to on the horizon. How do you feel about the fate of Akira Toriyama’s former home? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – @mr.gentleman1966 on Threads

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Highlights Culling Game Roster With New Posters Ahead of Season 4
content:
Jujutsu Kaisen is gearing up for a return to the Culling Game with a fun recap of the roster of fighters from its first half with some cool new posters ahead of the anime’s next new season. Jujutsu Kaisen really took over the world earlier this year when it hit screens with the anime’s third season, and with it kicked off the deadly Culling Game. This tournament had introduced fans to a whole new roster of characters with their own wild abilities , and there’s still much more to go.

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3: The Culling Game Part 1 saw the first half of Gege Akutami’s titular Culling Game arc adapted with its episodes when it aired as one of the most talked about new releases of the year thus far . But when it came to an end, there was a tease that there would be even more fights in the second half to come. To remind fans of some of the new faces in the mix ahead of the second half, Jujutsu Kaisen has shared some cool new posters for its characters you can check out below.

What’s Next for Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s Culling Game?

Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s third season wrapped up on a huge cliffhanger as it was really only the start of the Culling Game itself. While the third season saw Yuji, Megumi and Yuta getting through their first major fights , it was really only scratching the surface of everything that the Culling Game had to offer in total. The tournament has yet to reveal the first fights for Kinji Hakari, Panda, and Maki, and they will be coming across some brand new characters as well. There’s still quite a lot to to work through for the next phase of the arc.

The Culling Game is the penultimate arc of Gege Akutami’s original manga series overall, so this deadly tournament is just the first phase of a much wider plan that Sukuna will set in motion. It’s one fight after another from now on, and there will be even more chaos before it’s all said and done . It’s likely that this next season of the anime is going to be even wilder than what has been seen in the first three seasons thus far.

When Does Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Come Out?

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 is currently now in the works, but a release window or date has yet to be confirmed as of the time of this writing. Not much has been revealed about potential returning staff or voice cast as of this time either, but Takeru Sato will be taking over as director for the new season after serving as an assistant director with Season 3. If the third season was anything to go by, then fans can hope to see some big moments in this coming season too.

If you wanted to catch up with everything that’s gone down in the meantime, you can now find all three seasons as well as the Jujutsu Kaisen 0 movie now streaming with Crunchyroll. Jujutsu Kaisen is one of the franchises with something to showcase as part of Shueisha’s Jump Festa 2027 event later this December , so there’s a hope we’ll get a much needed Season 4 update there. How are you liking Jujutsu Kaisen’ s Culling Game arc in the anime so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: My Hero Academia, Frieren & More Anime Return for Spooky New Halloween Makeovers
content:
My Hero Academia , Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End, Oshi no Ko and more have gone all out for Halloween with some spooky makeovers for the holiday. The Halloween holiday is a pretty big deal in the anime world as it allows the production team for each franchise to play around a bit with the characters and their designs. Donning special looks for the spooky holiday, it’s also a way for dormant anime franchises to stay active while fans wait on those series to continue with more episodes.

My Hero Academia, Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End and Oshi no Ko are only a few of the franchises that went all in for the spooky holiday occasion, but it’s even more notable for them considering that they all are currently in the midst of production for their future episodes. With My Hero Academia , it’s not yet clear if it’s anime will continue after its TV finale either. So check out these cool Halloween tributes below with fun and spooky makeovers for each franchise.

Halloween 2026 Gets Special Anime Art and Tributes

The Apothecary Diaries is a particularly fun one as the franchise has shared three different Halloween illustrations for its characters, and fans are currently enjoying the third season of the TV anime series now airing its episodes this year. The anime will then take a break for a few months before it returns for its second half in April 2027. There’s also going to be a new feature film for the franchise hitting Japan later this December before it hits the United States and Canada sometime next year .

As for Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End , the manga has unfortunately been on hiatus for an entire year at this point with no signs of returning any time soon . But while fans are waiting for more of the manga, the third season of the anime is also now in the works for a release sometime in October 2027 with the anime’s biggest arc to date. But that’s opposite the case for My Hero Academia as the anime has no current plans slated for its future following its TV anime finale and epilogue released earlier this Summer.

What New Anime Is Great for Halloween?

It’s been a lot of grand finales for notable anime franchises lately too as Oshi no Ko is now in the works for its own ending too. Following the end of its third season, it was announced that the franchise is now in the works on its fourth and final season . Now release window has been announced for it either, but it’s certainly something to keep on your radar. If you’re looking for something Halloween based in particular, there are lots of fun options.

There are lots of spooky anime hits to watch on streaming platforms like Prime Video, Netflix, Hulu, Crunchyroll and more , but it might be tough to find an anime that’s truly steeper in horror. For one reason or another, it’s particularly tough to fully convey horror through animation but thankfully there are many shows like DAN DA DAN that use these ideas to a great extent. Are you diving into anime this Halloween? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Bleach’s Spinoff Would Be a Perfect New Anime After Finale Tease
content:
The Bleach anime has finally come to an end with the adaptation of the Thousand-Year Blood War , more than a decade after its manga first concluded. However, there are still many ways the series could be expanded, as the finale laid down several hints about the franchise’s future. One particularly interesting direction would be a spin-off, something the finale practically hinted at as well. The final episode of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War briefly showcased several smaller moments depicting the aftermath of the arc, showcasing a new world a decade later. A lot has happened in the ten years since then, and not all of it has been positive, with numerous complications emerging along the way.

One of the most intriguing details involves Shuhei Hisagi, the co-lieutenant of the 9th Division and Editor-in-Chief of the Seireitei Communication. In the opening minutes of the finale, while Rangiku and Hitsugaya are bantering about Shuhei needing to work harder and show more discipline, he reveals that he mastered his Bankai ages ago, specifically around a decade earlier. This is an intriguing detail because his Bankai was never actually depicted in the anime. However, this information comes from the spin-off series Bleach: Can’t Fear Your Own World , which features Shuhei as its protagonist and finally showcases him unleashing his Bankai.

Bleach: Can’t Fear Your Own World Is the Perfect Next Installment for the Franchise

Bleach: Can’t Fear Your Own World is a light novel series written by Ryōgo Narita, with illustrations by none other than the franchise’s creator, Tite Kubo. The three-volume light novel series takes place shortly after the events of the Thousand-Year Blood War arc and introduces a new threat spreading across the three realms. The tension begins when Shuhei, while carrying out his duties at the Seireitei Communication, notices disturbances among the noble houses of the Soul Society and a series of assassination attempts. As he investigates these incidents, new threats emerge, all connected to a plot to replace the Soul King.

At the center of this mysterious scheme is Tokinada Tsunayashiro, the leader of one of the four great noble houses, who is orchestrating everything to create a new Soul King. His plans eventually trigger disturbances across the three realms and bring the Quincy, Soul Reapers, and Arrancars into conflict. Shuhei’s investigation leads him deeper into the conspiracy until he eventually confronts the enemy. Along the way, Shuhei discovers the true identity of his Zanpakuto, unleashes his Bankai, and ultimately puts an end to the threat as the story’s protagonist.

Shuhei has always been one of the Soul Reapers fans wanted to learn more about, and it is a shame that the original series never showcased his Bankai, especially considering that he possesses one of the coolest Zanpakuto. The spin-off delivers the character development and reveals that the original series never gave this deserving character. The anime could follow the same direction, especially considering that the finale deliberately teased this possibility with a detail that was never included in the original manga. Bleach is far from over , and with several upcoming events expected to reveal what lies ahead for the franchise, an announcement about this spin-off could also be among them. It would be the perfect next installment.

title: Crunchyroll Confirms U.S. Release Date for Major Anime Movie Finale – Watch New Trailer
content:
A major anime franchise is coming to an end eight years after its original debut with a new feature film finale , and Crunchyroll has now confirmed its release date for fans in the United States with a new trailer and poster showing it all off. The anime adaptation for Hajime Kamoshida’s Rascal Does Not Dream light novel franchise is now working its way through theaters across Japan with the final entry in its near decade long run. This new feature film is serving as the grand finale, and thankfully fans outside of Japan will get to see it too.

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend is the final film in the franchise that originally began with Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai in 2018, and Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have now confirmed that they will be bringing the new film to theaters across the United States and Canada for a limited three days of screening on February 21st, 23rd, and 24th next year. You can check out the new trailer celebrating its international release below.

Rascal Does Not Dream Finale Movie Confirms U.S. Release Date

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend is now hitting theaters across Japan , and Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will then be bringing the film to theaters in the United States and Canada on February 21st, 23rd, and 24th next year. This three day only, limited time window for screening the film will be offering both Japanese and English dubbed audio for the occasion. Though it will likely depend on your local theater listings when the time comes. Either way, this is a big deal as it puts a final bow on the long running anime.

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend features a returning production staff from the TV anime franchise. Soichi Masui returns to direct the finale movie for CloverWorks with Aniplex handling the overall production. Masahiro Yokotani wrote the script, Satomi Tamura handled the characters, and fox capture plan composed the music. Picking up after the events of the second season, Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus , Mai Sakurajima is at the center once more as she has mysteriously disappeared out of reality .

How to Catch Up With Rascal Does Not Dream

If you wanted to catch up with everything that has released so far, it’s actually easier than ever to do so. The entire Rascal Does Not Dream franchise is now streaming with Crunchyroll exclusively with both Japanese and English language audio. This includes not only the main two seasons of the TV anime series, but also all three of the feature film OVA projects that had been released to tackle other novels in the series. And with this new movie, it’s all set to end.

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend is also the name of the final volume of Hajime Kamoshida’s original light novel releases, so there’s not much left for the story as Sakuta needs to chase after Mai one last time to finally get to the bottom of what’s really been going on with the Puberty Syndrome after all these years. Are you going to see the movie finale when it hits theaters? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend is the final film in the franchise that originally began with Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai in 2018, and Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have now confirmed that they will be bringing the new film to theaters across the United States and Canada for a limited three days of screening on February 21st, 23rd, and 24th next year. You can check out the new trailer celebrating its international release below.
Rascal Does Not Dream Finale Movie Confirms U.S. Release Date

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend is now hitting theaters across Japan , and Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will then be bringing the film to theaters in the United States and Canada on February 21st, 23rd, and 24th next year. This three day only, limited time window for screening the film will be offering both Japanese and English dubbed audio for the occasion. Though it will likely depend on your local theater listings when the time comes. Either way, this is a big deal as it puts a final bow on the long running anime.

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend features a returning production staff from the TV anime franchise. Soichi Masui returns to direct the finale movie for CloverWorks with Aniplex handling the overall production. Masahiro Yokotani wrote the script, Satomi Tamura handled the characters, and fox capture plan composed the music. Picking up after the events of the second season, Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus , Mai Sakurajima is at the center once more as she has mysteriously disappeared out of reality .
How to Catch Up With Rascal Does Not Dream

If you wanted to catch up with everything that has released so far, it’s actually easier than ever to do so. The entire Rascal Does Not Dream franchise is now streaming with Crunchyroll exclusively with both Japanese and English language audio. This includes not only the main two seasons of the TV anime series, but also all three of the feature film OVA projects that had been released to tackle other novels in the series. And with this new movie, it’s all set to end.

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend is also the name of the final volume of Hajime Kamoshida’s original light novel releases, so there’s not much left for the story as Sakuta needs to chase after Mai one last time to finally get to the bottom of what’s really been going on with the Puberty Syndrome after all these years. Are you going to see the movie finale when it hits theaters? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Demon Slayer Drops Cute New Look at the Coolest Hashira Ahead of Infinity Castle Part 2
content:
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba fans are still waiting on the next Infinity Castle movie , but the franchise has dropped a cute new look at the Sound Hashira, Tengen Uzui, to help celebrate his birthday in the meantime. Demon Slayer has been having a strong year as with the release of the first film in the Infinity Castle trilogy last year, the franchise has made its return this year with its official worldwide streaming launch . Which means fans have gotten to see the Hashira in action whenever they want.

It’s a bit of a different case for Tengen Uzui, however, as following his major battle during the events of Demon Slayer: Entertainment District Arc , Tengen had been retired from action due to the extent of his many injuries . That means we likely won’t see much of him even with the two new movies on the way. Thankfully, the franchise has dropped some cute new art for the Hashira to help celebrate his birthday, October 31st, and you can check it out below.

What’s Next for Tengen in Demon Slayer ?

Tengen Uzui was last fully seen at the end of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba ‘s TV anime series. With the Hashira Training Arc seeing the Hashira train the rest of the corps , Tengen was revealed to be one of the trainers despite the fact that he’s no longer in active duty in the fight against Muzan Kibutsuji. He was not brought into the Infinity Castle with the rest of the Demon Slayer corps, and that means we likely won’t see him again until all of the fights have come to an end with the final moments of the trilogy.

Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle has been touting that it’s going to be adapting the massive Infinity Castle arc from Koyoharu Gotoge’s original manga across its three planned films, but it’s currently unclear as to whether or not this will include the final arc of the series as a part of it. There’s one final battle that serves as its own arc after this one, but this feature film trilogy might also be serving as a grand finale for the anime franchise instead. Given its continued success for just the first film alone, no one could really blame the production team for going this route with it either.

When Does Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 2 Come Out?

Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle II has yet to reveal a release date or window as of this time, nor has it revealed any of the production staff or cast behind it all. Studio Ufotable is once again behind its production, and will likely begin to reveal more information about the film following the release of their current film project, Witch on the Holy Night , this Fall . They will likely have more room to promote their next project, and hopefully it’s the next step in the trilogy.

Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba has been confirmed to be one of the many franchises with something to showcase during Shueisha’s Jump Festa 2027 event coming later this December . It’s unclear as to what kind of announcement could be made during its panel that December 19-20 weekend, or if there’s going to be a future announcement at all, but it’s definitely a great step forward. Are you hoping to see more of Tengen before Demon Slayer ‘s anime end? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Seth MacFarlane & American Dad Honor Patrick Stewart With Tribute: “Deeply Missed By the Entire Planet”
content:
Legendary star of stage and screen Patrick Stewart has sadly passed away at the age of 86 this week , and American Dad! and franchise creator Seth MacFarlane have shared emotional tributes to the star thanks to all of the work he’s done across MacFarlane’s works like American Dad!, Family Guy, Ted and more. Stewart might be more prominently remembered for all of his big screen accomplishments over his lengthy career, but MacFarlane gave the actor tons of opportunity to flex more of his comedic muscles with wild voice roles.

Patrick Stewart not only reprise his role as himself in episodes of Family Guy , but was also used as the inner monologue of Joe Swanson’s baby daughter, as the narrator of the Ted feature films, and arguably his most iconic animated series role as Avery Bullock in American Dad! since its very first season . Both MacFarlane and American Dad! took to social media to share their tributes with MacFarlane stating, “We have lost a legendary actor today, and for many of us, a good friend. He will be deeply missed by the entire planet.”

Seth MacFarlane Pays Tribute to Patrick Stewart

“Patrick was one of those icons who we somehow all took for granted would always be with us,” MacFarlane stated. “I grew up as a fan, and was later gifted the privilege of becoming a colleague and friend, working with him for many years on ‘American Dad!’, ‘Family Guy’, and ‘Ted’ . He was that rare actor who could take any bit of dialogue and elevate it, making a good writer sound great, and a great writer sound masterful.” As MacFarlane continued with the tribute, he had nothing but glowing praise for the late actor.

“He was also as humble as they come,” MacFarlane continued. “I remember exchanging emails with him a number of years ago when he was beginning day 1 of a new film. He commented to me that he always walked onto a new set feeling like the biggest novice there,” which is a great look into the late actor’s own personality . “My stunned reaction was the same as anyone’s would be. I said, ‘Patrick, if you feel that way, the rest of us are screwed.’ We have lost a legendary actor today, and for many of us, a good friend. He will be deeply missed by the entire planet.”

American Dad! Says Goodbye to Patrick Stewart

It’s hard to image American Dad! without Patrick Stewart as Head of the CIA, Avery Bullock, has been around as Stan’s boss since the very first season. Starting out a bit more serious with wacky tendencies, the later seasons had turned Bullock fully unhinged as Patrick Stewart was able to say some of the wildest things possible. And the show itself has nothing but gratitude for the late star, “We at American Dad! have so much gratitude and love for Patrick Stewart.”

“He said how happy he was to do American Dad! because he was so rarely asked to do comedy, which is insane, as his ability to get the laugh was uncanny,” their statement continued. “Thank you, Sir, for sharing your joyful spirit, inspiring voice, and willingness to be ridiculous. You turned Avery Bullock, Deputy Director of the CIA, into someone the world loved and couldn’t get enough of. We will miss you.” While Disney had confirmed that Stewart’s final onscreen performance will be in Avengers: Doomsday later this year, it’s yet to be revealed whether or not he had recorded any lines for American Dad’ s next season yet.

What are your favorite Patrick Stewart moments from Seth MacFarlane’s extended universe? What’s your favorite Bullock episode of American Dad ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: DC Studios’ New Green Lantern Animated Series Confirms Episode Count With Promising Update
content:
Warner Bros. Animation and DC Studios are now in the works on a new animated series set in the same universe as My Adventures with Superman , and Peter Safran has shared a promising update on how it’s all coming along with a confirmation of how long it’s debut outing is going to be. My Adventures with Green Lantern has been announced as an extension of the My Adventures with Superman universe, and features a young hero that quietly made her first appearance during My Adventures with Superman ‘s third season .

There have been some worries among fans as the animated series has been in development during the course of Warner Bros. and Paramount’s merge into Skydance , but everything continues to move forward as DC Studios co-chairman and co-CEO Peter Safran told Collider that they are currently “reviewing animatics and animation” for My Adventures with Green Lantern ‘s ten half-hour episodes.

My Adventures with Green Lantern Confirms Episode Count With Production Update

When asked about My Adventures with Green Lantern and whether or not it shares any similarities with its My Adventures with Superman predecessor, Safran revealed that the new animated series is “Tonally similar,” but remarked that “Obviously, thematically very different because it’s dealing with different characters and different lore , but the things that I loved so much about My Adventures with Superman are firmly in My Adventures with Green Lantern .” Thankfully, it also seems far into its production process too, “We’re in the stages of reviewing animatics and animation on that right now.”

My Adventures with Green Lantern has been confirmed to take place within the same universe as the Superman series, and that’s great news considering that My Adventures with Superman has yet to reveal any word on its own potential future with a fourth season . All those involved behind the scenes seem to be down for it, but it’s going to be up to DC Studios as to whether or not the main animated series continues. At least this new spinoff will have something great to chew on in the meantime.

What to Know for My Adventures with Green Lantern

My Adventures with Green Lantern has yet to confirm a release window or date as of the time of this writing, unfortunately. Featuring My Adventures with Superman producer Jake Wyatt as executive producer and Stephanie Gonzaga as co-producer, the new animated series will star Auli’l Cravalho as the voice of a young Jessica Cruz following her cameo debut in My Adventures with Superman Season 3. But it’s going in a different direction than that main series with a different anime as the source of inspiration.

As for what anime it’s going to be influenced by, Wyatt teased that it’s going to feel familiar to classic Toonami anime fans much like how their rebooted take on Superman was, “Our take on Superman is very obviously inspired by Dragon Ball Z , among other things; there’s a lot of anime influence. Lantern is inspired by a very different part of the same Toonami block.” There’s a theory that it’s going the Sailor Moon route, and that makes it all the more intriguing.

What are you hoping to see from My Adventures with Green Lantern ? Are you excited to see this animated universe continue? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – Collider

title: Romelia War Chronicle Anime's 2nd Part Unveils April 2027 Debut, Ending Song's Artist
content:
The staff of the television anime of Ryō Ariyama 's Romelia War Chronicle: Even After Defeating the Demon King, Humanity Still Seems Doomed, So I Formed a Military Force ( Romelia Senki: Maō o Taoshita Ato mo Jinrui Yabasō Dakara Guntai Soshiki Shita ) light novel series announced the April 2027 television premiere and the ending theme song artist for the anime's second cours (quarter of a year) on Saturday. Hiro Shimono is performing the ending song for the second part.

Seven Seas licensed the novels' manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam. With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.

The anime premiered first via streaming in Japan on U-NEXT , Anime Times , and Netflix on October 3 at 9:00 p.m. (8:00 a.m. EDT). The anime then aired on October 5 at 11:30 p.m. (10:30 a.m. EDT) on the Tokyo MX , BS11 , Sun TV , and KBS Kyoto channels. The anime will run for two cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired.

Ariyama launched the light novel series as a web novel on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2019, before being published under Shogakukan 's Gagaga Bunko imprint. The series currently has over 550,000 copies in circulation, and ended in its sixth volume in November 2025. Kodama illustrated the first novel volume and Ryō Kamito illustrated volumes 2-6.

Seven Seas released the third volume on August 11.

The manga series adaptation with art by Ryō Kamito launched on Mag Garden 's Mag Comi platform in January 2022.
